n.location: p. 41, Table 16 note; p. 42, Table 17 note

reported_success.quote: Therefore, we conclude that we found no support for Hypothesis 3a and 3b.

notes: The supplied OSF file URL resolves to a preregistration manuscript explicitly using simulated Qualtrics data. Those simulated statistics were not used. The completed author preprint was obtained from the registered-from project hw4av, Preprint folder, file hn6xt; its title/authors, original studies and final-result page locators match the assignment. No conversions performed. Where a locator covers action identification and mind attribution, the high-level action-identification test is selected; the other outcome is described in notes. Original supplied p. 5 begins Study 3; numerical results appear on PDF p. 6. Neutral description includes multiple outcomes and mediation analyses and does not uniquely specify a test. Selected the primary suffering effect on action identification, paired to the same test in replication. Overall mind attribution is separately original F(1,57)=4.42, p<.05, η²=.07 and replication F(1,325)=.86, p=.355; mediation tests are different tests and are not combined. Original p=.05 is printed as equality, despite the replication paper’s retrospective description as p<.05.
